text: There is no treatment for cysticercosis (Taenia larval cysts) in cattle or swine — prevention and treatment of Taenia itself needs to happen in humans (the tapeworm's final host). For Fasciola (liver fluke) and other roundworms, two options: Ivermectin combined with Clorsulon (easy to inject, but Clorsulon doesn't kill Fasciola eggs, so regular re-treatment is needed) or Albendazole, the most widely used option in Cambodia, which kills both roundworms and Fasciola (adults and eggs).
